object_description: large square solitaire with an inner courtyard
design_condition: Centered on the site and turned away from the street alignments, the compact volume creates three spacious outdoor areas and preserves land reserves for future development.

positive.statement: The simple, urban volumetric solution corresponds to the large scale of the surrounding area.
The open spaces are pleasantly simple, atmospheric, and of good user quality.
The consistent grid allows one-, two-, or three-bay typologies and provides the required flexibility.
Despite its simplicity, the building has a distinct identity and clear address.
The compact building shape creates a favorable ratio of floor space to building envelope.

negative.statement: The mezzanine level is only partially developed and does not function; the auditorium requires more interior space and a larger anteroom.
The main usable areas are imbalanced, with too much central space and substantial shortages for offices and laboratories.
Seven sufficiently high floors do not fit within the maximum permitted building height.
The crossed double staircases appear somewhat over-instrumented.
The everything-under-one-roof concept reaches spatial, geometric, and operational limits.
